title: Executable evidence snapshot entered Bun test discovery
symptom: The REL10 full check discovered a historical HUD verifier snapshot stored under the durable review evidence tree as `release-hud-lifecycle.test.ts`. Bun executed it as a 75th test file, and its historical relative import resolved from the evidence directory instead of the repository source location. The run ended with 672 passes, 5 intentional parser skips, 1 failure and 1 unhandled module-resolution error.

rootCause.summary: Bun recursively discovers filenames ending in `.test.ts` outside the active `test/` tree. A byte-for-byte historical source snapshot retained its executable test suffix inside documentation evidence, so evidence storage accidentally expanded the runnable suite. The active test and product code were not defective.

requestedOutcome: Keep the historical HUD source bytes and their original names/digests auditable without making archived evidence executable or discoverable as an active test, then pass the complete repository check with the active suite unchanged.
decisions: Store executable source snapshots in durable evidence with an additional `.txt` suffix and a machine-readable mapping back to each original filename and SHA-256.
Preserve the original digest list and explain the storage transformation; do not delete the snapshot, skip a test, narrow test discovery or reinterpret the failed run.
Treat the first full-check failure as evidence-storage auto-discovery, while preserving the five optional parser skips as skips rather than passes.

actions.description: Rename the two historical HUD source snapshots to `.mjs.txt` and `.test.ts.txt` while preserving their bytes and original SHA-256 values.
Add a storage map and README that bind stored names to original names/digests and state that no active test was skipped or removed.
Rerun the complete repository check and retain both the original failure and closure output.

verification.name: Evidence snapshot storage and full-check closure
verification.scope: Byte identity of the two archived HUD source snapshots, exclusion of the archived `.test.ts` suffix from Bun discovery, and the complete repository check including issue validation, generated-data checks, layout checks, Bun tests, TypeScript and shell syntax.
verification.result: The stored `.txt` snapshots match the original SHA-256 values recorded in `SHA256SUMS` and `storage-map.json`. The complete rerun exited zero with 672 passes, 5 intentional parser skips, 0 failures, 3,613 assertions and 74 active test files in 140.57 seconds; the trailing TypeScript and shell checks also completed as part of the successful chained command.

related.note: Original full-check output retaining the 75th discovered evidence test, relative-import error, 672 passes, 5 skips, 1 failure and exit 1.
Machine-readable original-to-stored filename map with byte digests for both historical snapshots.
Successful complete rerun after the evidence-only storage correction.

history.summary: The first REL10 full check auto-discovered the historical evidence file `release-hud-lifecycle.test.ts`; its source-relative import was invalid from the evidence directory, producing 672 passes, 5 skips, 1 failure, 1 error and command exit 1.

The failure was traced to Bun filename discovery of a historical evidence snapshot, not to the active HUD verifier or product runtime. The source snapshots were stored under additional `.txt` suffixes with byte-identical digest mapping.
The unchanged active suite and complete chained check passed after the evidence-only rename: 672 passes, 5 skips, 0 failures, 3,613 assertions and 74 files. No active test was removed or skipped.
The opt-in terminal HUD was removed on 2026-10-22 (user decision). Related test test/release-hud-lifecycle.test.ts was deleted with it; this resolution and its evidence are unchanged.
